title: Renewal generation race
preconditions: all enforcing replicas refer to one configured logical session-authorization owner
a committed successor is installed at that owner before the hostile predecessor replay
separate reset branches exercise precommit concurrency response loss and terminal invalidation
steps: Race two fresh renewal attempts against one predecessor; lose a committed response; try cancellation and a second grant. Install the exact successor, then replay the predecessor at another replica or deliver success after termination.
the primary rejection is the old predecessor presented after owner installation; owner unavailability in a separate branch is unavailable rather than stale-cache authorization
committed response loss permits only exact-artifact redelivery before deadlines; precommit cancellation may retry with a fresh challenge but cannot roll back consumption or temporal state
invariants: M1-015 R06: Session termination racing renewal commit/installation prevents activation and cannot recreate deleted active state
M1-015 R07: Two attempts using the same predecessor yield at most one committed successor; retries cannot roll back temporal high-water
M1-015 R08: Delayed predecessor delivery after successor installation cannot restore older rights; duplicate current-artifact delivery cannot extend time
M1-015 R13: After owner installation/termination, another RP replica cannot authorize from stale local state; inability to consult coherent owner state is unavailable
M1-015 R14: Committed successor response loss permits only exact-artifact redelivery before deadlines; cancellation cannot mint another successor from its predecessor
residual_risk: The scenario specifies required ordering; it does not supply a distributed transaction or liveness proof.
Specified attack requirement only; runtime implementation and proof remain deferred.
